plan.overview: Create comprehensive tests for vision_session and vision_commands modules following TDD RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle

tests: create_session_test: Verify session created with correct initial state
create_session_fields_test: Verify all fields set correctly
create_session_empty_collections_test: Verify answers/gaps/conflicts start empty
record_answer_test: Verify answer added to session
record_answer_updates_timestamp_test: Verify updated_at changes
record_answer_multiple_test: Verify multiple answers accumulate
record_answer_preserves_order_test: Verify answers maintain insertion order
find_answer_existing_test: Verify Some returned for existing answer
find_answer_missing_test: Verify None returned for missing question
find_answer_multiple_test: Verify correct answer found among many
get_answered_count_empty_test: Verify 0 for new session
get_answered_count_one_test: Verify 1 after one answer
get_answered_count_multiple_test: Verify correct count with multiple answers
build_vision_section_complete_test: Verify Ok with all required fields
build_vision_section_missing_press_release_test: Verify Error for missing press_release
build_vision_section_missing_persona_test: Verify Error for missing persona
build_vision_section_missing_non_personas_test: Verify Error for missing non_personas
build_vision_section_missing_north_star_test: Verify Error for missing north_star
build_vision_section_missing_vorp_test: Verify Error for missing vorp
build_vision_section_missing_scenarios_test: Verify Error for missing scenarios
build_vision_section_missing_out_of_scope_test: Verify Error for missing out_of_scope
build_vision_section_optional_replaces_test: Verify replaces can be None
build_vision_section_list_parsing_test: Verify comma/newline list parsing
create_command_session_test: Verify session created with correct initial state
create_command_session_fields_test: Verify all fields initialized correctly
create_command_session_initial_status_test: Verify status is CommandInProgress
create_command_session_score_zero_test: Verify critique_score starts at 0
get_status_string_in_progress_test: Verify 'in_progress' string
get_status_string_ready_for_critique_test: Verify 'ready_for_critique' string
get_status_string_complete_test: Verify 'complete' string
record_response_test: Verify response added to session
record_response_updates_timestamp_test: Verify updated_at changes
record_response_multiple_test: Verify multiple responses tracked
record_response_overwrites_test: Verify same issue_id overwrites previous response
set_status_ready_for_critique_test: Verify status transitions to ReadyForCritique
set_status_complete_test: Verify status transitions to Complete with score
set_status_complete_updates_count_test: Verify issues_addressed updated
agree_session_success_test: Verify Ok when score >= 70 and status Complete
agree_session_low_score_test: Verify Error when score < 70
agree_session_not_complete_test: Verify Error when status not Complete
agree_session_sets_finalized_at_test: Verify finalized_at set on success
agree_session_boundary_70_test: Verify exactly 70 score passes
agree_session_boundary_69_test: Verify 69 score fails
session_to_json_test: Verify JSON contains all fields
session_to_json_status_string_test: Verify status converted to string
session_to_json_finalized_none_test: Verify null for None finalized_at
session_to_json_finalized_some_test: Verify string for Some finalized_at
empty_vision_section_test: Verify empty section has empty strings and lists
sample_complete_vision_test: Verify sample has all required fields populated
sample_complete_vision_scenarios_test: Verify sample has 2 scenarios

implementation_order: 2. Run gleam test - verify tests fail
6. Run gleam test - verify tests fail
9. Run gleam format on both test files
edge_cases_covered: Find operations on empty and populated collections
List parsing with comma and newline separators
gleam_conventions_applied: Immutability: Use spread operator for session updates
Result types: Test both Ok and Error paths
Exhaustive matching: Pattern match on Option (Some/None) and Result (Ok/Error)
Pipelines: Use |> in test setup where appropriate
Pure functions: All tests are deterministic with no side effects

success_criteria: All public functions in vision_session have tests
All public functions in vision_commands have tests
Tests cover happy path and error cases
